newsitem.title: USA: St. Joseph Light & Power wins waiver.
newsitem.headline: St. Joseph Light & Power wins waiver.

text.p: St. Joseph Light & Power Co said Wednesday the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission granted a waiver of a rule that utilities separate power marketing efforts from their transmission operations.
The regulatory panel said it granted the company's waiver request because St. Joseph Light & Power is considered a small utility with fewer than four million megawatt-hours of sales annually.
The company provides electricity to 61,000 customers in parts of 10 counties in northwest Missouri.
St. Joseph Light & Power stock was unchanged at 15.
